changelog: Owners are no longer locked out when the central PIN service is unavailable, and the PIN pad is cleared after choosing a notebook. A device that connects catches up even when no other device is open: two durable relays (Supabase, then Firebase), each with a daily data budget per device, and direct device-to-device sync as the last fallback. Photos stay device-to-device. Inventory, money and movements untouched.
